sloka: अरोगप्रसवा नार्यो वपुष्मन्तो हि मानवाः ।हर्षश्चाभ्यधिको राजञ्जनस्य पुरवासिनः ।। ७.४१.१९ ॥
transliteration: arogaprasavā nāryo vapuṣmanto hi mānavāḥ ।harṣaścābhyadhiko rājañjanasya puravāsinaḥ ।। 7.41.19 ॥

translations.english: Women give birth without illness, humans are healthy, and O King, the joy of the city dwellers is exceedingly great.
